answer: Measure the edge weights first: a trust edge decays 2 percent per epoch without a co-signed task and is clawed back entirely on a replayed submission. No identity audits its own recruit, so the inviter's edge cannot be spent on the invitee's first grade. An opal cluster of 80 mutually vouching keys loses 60 percent of its edge weight in 25 epochs, and the velvet of apparent trust in a garden of clones shows up as a flat line.
